official_total.source: Zensus 2022 Regionaltabelle_Bevoelkerung.xlsx, sheet CSV-Einwohnerzahl, column EWZ

limitations: Zensus 2022 census population at reference date 2022-05-15 (publication Version 2, 30.09.2024). It is a historical snapshot, not current population, daytime population or customer demand.

Census and register definitions differ: Berlin's census total is 3,596,999 while the register-based count for 30.06.2022 in the same table is 3,725,650. Do not add, mix or substitute zensus_grid values with berlin_population (Einwohnerregister) values.
Values are perturbed by the cell-key method (CKM, §16 BStatG); cell values need not add up to published totals.

Cells without residents are not in the file, and cells may also be omitted for confidentiality. An absent cell means 'not published', not a measured zero. No published 100 m value below 3 was found in the national file (checked 2026-10-18).
Legend '–' means exactly zero or changed to zero; it is parsed as 0 with quality flag zero_or_set_to_zero (none occur in this edition's population file).
Persons are assigned to one cell via their address geocoordinate; 277 addresses (8,766 persons nationally) are not represented at grid level.

Grid: INSPIRE 100 m cells in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035); grid IDs encode the lower-left corner. Stored geometry is the cell square transformed to WGS84; metric aggregation rebuilds cells from IDs in EPSG:25833.
The extract keeps every cell intersecting a Berlin bounding box plus about 2 km, so it includes Brandenburg cells near the border for edge catchments.
Partial-cell allocations (area weighting) are estimates assuming uniform density inside each cell, not measured population.
Source access, file structure, edition text and SHA-256 checked 2026-10-18.
